description: a young storm drake whose breath is a rolling wall of thunder
canary: NOVA, mid CR — the band where our gated rows sat worst (0.54x of the round against print's 1.02x). Judge the breath against the Multiattack.

description: a brass tyrant whose furnace breath terrifies and whose hammer finds the terrified
canary: NOVA + PAYOFF at high CR. The payoff's save must not be Strength (print: 0 of 28 single-target damage rows).

description: a scree-pit thing that buries what it catches and crushes what it holds
canary: PAYOFF on a grappler — the critic's best-of-sweep sheet. Does the crush still price fairly against the round?

description: a cathedral bell given legs, whose toll builds to one shattering peal
canary: A WIND-UP nova: it keeps its Recharge (print gates 69 of 69) and the delay. Damage should now reach the round, not 0.6x of it.

description: an ancient drake of the ash wastes that rules a dead valley
canary: LEGENDARY, very high CR. cardBudget multiplies the target 1.25x here; print's CR 17+ median is only 0.53x of it, so do NOT read a low ratio as underpowered.

description: a plague-bearing archon of flies that commands lesser swarms
canary: CR 11-16 band, where print dips hardest (0.63x). Also the sheet whose Swarm Sovereignty shipped mid-sentence — the unfinished-text lint should now drop such a row.

description: a knife ball of lashed blades that rolls over everything
canary: The owner's spot check: 'Recharge novas should be a little frightening.' Rolling Blades was 22 against a 34 round.

description: a bog hag who curses trespassers and drowns them in the mire
canary: LOW CR, where PRINT runs hottest (median 1.00x, p95 1.67x). Hot is fine here; grossly over is above 1.67x.

description: a goblin boss who shoves allies into harm's way
canary: CR 1 — the shove must keep its Strength save (print's Strength is for displacement) while damage rows must not take it.

description: a pumpkin king whose roots snare and drag
canary: The owner's spot check: the snare read 'until the Restrained is destroyed'. It must now name a real object, and the sheet was 'quite spare' for CR 10.

description: a drowned choir that sings sailors down
canary: A CASTER-ish control sheet. Six action rows last sweep; watch action economy as well as DPR.

description: a swarm of carrion beetles that boils over the fallen
canary: SWARM — print's seven swarms make exactly one attack, so the round is small by design. A low ratio here may be correct.
